scripts.release:patch: bun pm version patch && git push && git push --tags && GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) bun publish
scripts.release:minor: bun pm version minor && git push && git push --tags && GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) bun publish
scripts.release:major: bun pm version major && git push && git push --tags && GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) bun publish
